text:
Jamie: Morning 09:03 PT. Quick plan: rolling out a tiny 'preview heatmap' to prioritize onboarding invites and catch renewal-risk flags early. Objectives: (A) 3-question micro-form, (B) auto-score urgency + infra needs, (C) schedule 20-min handoffs or slot into cohort office hours. Draft form: https://redwood.ai/forms/preview-heatmap-v1

Nina: Keep the form lean. Suggested questions: 'main integration (api/embeddings/chat)', 'launch timeline (weeks)', 'security: none/KMS/HSM/enterprise'. Add optional free-text: 'biggest blocker'.

Ravi: I'll add a lightweight risk heuristic mapping to Coda. Idea: short contracts + rapid uptake -> renewal risk. Also include a 'primary metric' field so Product can correlate feedback (latency/cost/accuracy).

Tori_ops: Capacity note: we can cover 12x 20-min 1:1s/week for next 3 weeks. Overflow -> weekly cohort on Tue 11am PT. If many need peering or dedicated IPs, we should triage to infra early.

Nina: Proposed scoring: `score = min(12, floor(log10(monthly_calls+1))*2) + (security!='none')*4 + (launch_weeks<8)*3`. Anything >=11 gets 1:1. I'll add column in export.

autobot: form 'preview-heatmap-v1' created by jamie_cs at 2025-01-08T16:03:00Z -> https://redwood.ai/forms/preview-heatmap-v1

Jamie: Action items: @nina_se finalize scoring & push CSV to Coda by EOD; @ravi_prod publish 1-pager with 20-min agenda + invite template; @tori_ops confirm overflow plan and post link to cohort; I'll run the first outreach wave targeting score>=11.

Nina: Got it 09:12 44d I'll run the query and drop results to Coda. SQL I'll use: `SELECT acct, company, sum(api_calls) as monthly_calls, tags, contract_months FROM accounts WHERE created_at > now()-interval '90 days' GROUP BY acct,company,tags,contract_months ORDER BY monthly_calls DESC LIMIT 500;`

Ravi: Drafted the 1-pager + invite in Coda: https://coda.io/d/preview-heatmap#Onboard. Includes checklist: API key, sample prompt, expected QPS.

Tori_ops: Confirmed capacity and cohort link posted. If >15/wk we escalate to product for extra slots. Recommend batching invites Mon morning to smooth load.

Jamie: Great 44aa 4aa I'll start outreach Mon AM. We'll reconvene next Thu for a rollup of feedback fields and any emergent infra asks. Thanks team!
